messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning to create release/1.12.2 branch in ~2 hours (14:00 PT). Main tasks: version bump, changelog, run upgrade tests. Any mandatory cherry-picks or backports?

sam: +1 on timing. I have a small metrics fix (PR #4860) that should be backported — it affects stability.

julian: Quick reminder of backport rules: only bugfixes and security fixes after cutoff. No new flags or perf experiments. If you want a cherry-pick, add the label backport/1.12 and ping me.

maya: @sam please add the label and paste the PR link here. Also, @julian can you do the backport when I create the branch?

sam: Done: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4860 labeled backport/1.12.

leo: Heads-up — docs-only PRs (like #4855) can wait for patch release, but if changelog needs it, add a one-line note.

maya: Plan for branch creation: I'll run the usual commands and then run the CI smoke. Command I'm going to use:

```
# from main
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/1.12.2 origin/main
# apply version bump commit if not already merged
# push and create branch on repo
git push origin release/1.12.2
```

maya: After branch is up I'll ask @release-bot to tag and block merges to main->release until backports land.

release-bot: :gear: Created branch release/1.12.2 at commit 6b7a9f2. Protected branch rules applied (no direct pushes).

maya: Thanks bot. @julian if you can start the backport PRs against release/1.12.2 for #4860 that'd be great. Also reminder: cutoff for non-critical fixes is 16:00 PT.

julian: Copy. Starting with #4860. If I hit any conflicts I'll post here.

eva: Small ask — can we include a short changelog blurb for the metrics fix? I can draft it.

sam: That would help. Draft: "Fix metrics ingestion race causing dropped events in high-load scenarios." Feel free to edit.

maya: Perfect — @eva please add that under docs/changelogs/1.12.2.md and link the PR. We'll merge changelog to release branch once backports pass CI.

leo: Also note: post-cutoff we only accept security patches. If anyone thinks something is security-related, flag it with security/backport.

julian: Backport PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4901 -> base release/1.12.2. CI kicked off.

maya: Great. I'll monitor CI and coordinate the branch freeze at cutoff. Thanks all — ping here if you find other must-have fixes. :thumbsup:
